locomo.title: LoCoMo (original public release)
locomo.official_suite_name: LoCoMo original; related to but not the AML LoCoMo-Refined bundle
locomo.attribution: Maharana et al., SNAP Research; LoCoMo: Long-Context Conversation Understanding with Memory Operations
locomo.evaluation: source-turn evidence recall, hit rate, and multi-evidence chain coverage
locomo.notes: Original SNAP release, not the AML LoCoMo-Refined frozen bundle.

longmemeval-s.title: LongMemEval-S (author cleaned public release)
longmemeval-s.attribution: Di Wu, Hongwei Wang, Wenhao Yu, Yuwei Zhang, Kai-Wei Chang, and Dong Yu; LongMemEval (ICLR 2025)
longmemeval-s.evaluation: has_answer turn/session evidence recall; upstream answer QA judge is a separate optional stage
longmemeval-s.notes: Pinned author dataset revision. Record and verify the local SHA-256 after download.

locomo-refined-community.title: LoCoMo-Refined (public community release candidate)
locomo-refined-community.source_class: third-party benchmark release based on SNAP LoCoMo
locomo-refined-community.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (community release; review NOTICE and upstream rights)
locomo-refined-community.processing: Pair public questions with the corresponding conversation/session history; preserve the community release revision and evidence annotation. No adapter in this workspace yet.
locomo-refined-community.evaluation: Community README describes answer evaluation/judging. Inspect labels and rubric before mapping evidence to Add/Search; not verified as AML's exact frozen bundle.
locomo-refined-community.identity_warning: This is a community repository using the LoCoMo-Refined name. Its relationship to the AML evaluation bundle is unverified; do not report it as the official AML release.

longmemeval-m.title: LongMemEval-M (author release)
longmemeval-m.processing: Same record family as S; keep full session history for a faithful run. Avoid loading the entire file into memory; current converter streams rows but a single selected question can still be very large.
longmemeval-m.evaluation: Turn evidence recall is possible from has_answer; full QA requires the author's separate evaluator.

longmemeval-oracle.title: LongMemEval Oracle (author release)
longmemeval-oracle.source_class: benchmark author release with gold evidence sessions only
longmemeval-oracle.processing: Use only as an evidence-pipeline sanity check. Its histories contain only gold evidence sessions, so retrieval difficulty is lower than S/M.
longmemeval-oracle.evaluation: Author QA evaluator accepts the Oracle file; do not compare its score directly with S/M.

scriptmem.title: ScriptMem v1.0
scriptmem.source_class: benchmark author release; source scripts omitted
scriptmem.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for ScriptMem-created benchmark materials only
scriptmem.processing: Can inspect question types/options/metadata. Original scripts and source dialogues are not released; never synthesize Add history from gold questions or answers.
scriptmem.evaluation: Author benchmark uses unified answer generation and accuracy. Not currently suitable for full local Add/Search replay without licensed source conversations.

clbench.title: CL-bench
clbench.source_class: Tencent Hunyuan and Fudan NLP benchmark release
clbench.license: Custom evaluation-only license; prohibits training, fine-tuning, calibration, distillation, adaptation, and parameter updates
clbench.processing: Separate context/history from the task in messages. Keep rubrics out of Add/Search and use only in an explicitly enabled evaluator. Map evidence only where source spans are available.
clbench.evaluation: Rubric-based task evaluation, not retrieval recall alone.

clbench-life.title: CL-bench Life
clbench-life.source_class: Tencent Hunyuan and Fudan NLP benchmark release
clbench-life.license: Custom evaluation-only license; benchmark use only, no parameter updates
clbench-life.processing: Separate context/history and final task; keep rubric labels out of memory writes. Build a task adapter and evaluator before using for scores.
clbench-life.evaluation: Rubric-based task evaluation over everyday-context cases; no source-span retrieval metric is supplied by the card.

personamem-v2.title: PersonaMem-v2
personamem-v2.source_class: Penn author repository and Hugging Face dataset
personamem-v2.format: CSV splits plus referenced conversation-history files
personamem-v2.license: CC BY 4.0 (author Hugging Face dataset card; verify linked history files individually)
personamem-v2.processing: Pin split and persona IDs, retrieve the referenced 32K or 128K history, and Add only the history. Search user_query. Preference labels, correct/incorrect answers, and related snippets remain evaluator-side.
personamem-v2.evaluation: Personalization answer accuracy / preference update tasks; evidence retrieval diagnostics need source alignment.

beam.title: BEAM (128K/500K/1M)
beam.format: conversation rows with chat, user_questions, probing_questions and metadata
beam.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for benchmark data; code is MIT and has a separate license
beam.processing: Start with one 128K conversation; stream the row, convert chat turns into bounded Add calls, and keep probing questions/answers outside Add. Use author's evaluator for answer scoring.
beam.evaluation: Ten memory abilities and generated probes; evidence-only retrieval is a diagnostic proxy, not the full score.

beam-10m.title: BEAM-10M
beam-10m.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for benchmark data; verify the dataset card at the pinned revision
beam-10m.processing: Separate opt-in stress tier. Do not fetch by default. Requires streaming import, storage and request-budget estimates before a run.
beam-10m.evaluation: Use the author evaluator for question/answer scoring; report latency/cost separately.
